themes_detail.label: Tree branches hazard spike
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints surged to 3 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2300% spike (z-score 8.69)—suggesting either a weather event, deferred maintenance, or new hazard conditions creating immediate safety risk in Mott Haven/Melrose.
evidence: 3 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 8.69 indicates statistically extreme deviation
reporting_angles: Was there a weather event (wind, storm) that triggered branch falls this week? Interview Parks Dept.
Identify specific street segments with complaints; photograph conditions and assess public safety risk
Cross-reference with DOB permits to see if any tree work was halted or delayed

themes_detail.label: Plumbing complaints accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Plumbing complaints jumped 44% LAST WEEK to 45 complaints versus 31.2 weekly average (z-score 2.81), suggesting acute housing infrastructure stress—potentially linked to water main breaks, building system failures, or seasonal pressure on aging building stock.
evidence: 45 plumbing complaints last week vs. 31.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Plumbing ranks 6th in 90-day complaint volume (432 total complaints)
reporting_angles: Interview DEP about water main breaks or system pressure issues in CD 201 over the past 10 days
File FOIL for Department of Buildings inspection records on plumbing violations filed last week
Visit affected buildings; identify whether older structures or specific blocks are experiencing cascading failures

themes_detail.label: General 311 complaints surge
themes_detail.summary: General/uncategorized 311 complaints rose 62% LAST WEEK to 22 complaints versus 13.6 weekly average (z-score 2.83), indicating residents are reporting issues that don't fit standard categories—a sign of emerging, novel, or complex problems.
evidence: 22 general complaints last week vs. 13.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Suggests unclassified or emerging issue types not captured by standard complaint categories
reporting_angles: Request 311 data warehouse access to read text of last week's general complaints and identify common themes
Survey local civic groups and tenant associations about what residents are frustrated with that isn't being captured
Interview 311 intake staff about trends in call content they're observing

themes_detail.label: Cannabis retail complaints clustering
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints peaked 3 WEEKS AGO at 6 complaints versus 1.5 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 3.0)—indicating ongoing enforcement or community concerns about unlicensed dispensaries, now cooling but worth verifying if illicit retail has stabilized or shifted.
evidence: 6 cannabis retailer complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Peak has subsided but baseline remains elevated; unclear if issue resolved or complaints ceased
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD and State Liquor Authority about enforcement actions against unlicensed dispensaries in Mott Haven/Melrose 3-4 weeks ago
Map the 6 complaints geographically; determine if they cluster on specific blocks and whether those locations still have illicit retail
Speak with community board and local merchants about impact of cannabis retail on street conditions and quality of life

themes_detail.label: Safety complaints elevated
themes_detail.summary: Safety-related 311 complaints rose 70% TWO WEEKS AGO to 7 complaints versus 4.1 weekly average (z-score 2.27), indicating a brief spike in public safety concerns that have since moderated—worth investigating what triggered the surge.
evidence: 7 safety complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Baseline is low; spike is relative but represents 71% jump in citizen-reported safety issues
reporting_angles: Review NYPD crime statistics and incident reports for the same 2-week window to see if complaints align with actual crime data
Contact community safety groups and precinct council to ask what safety events they're aware of from 2 weeks ago
Read 311 complaint text to identify whether reports were about street violence, building safety, or other categories
